answer_1.quote: Controllable text generation aims to generate text in a controlled way, such as transferring text style and generating text with control codes.
answer_1.outputs: fluent and diverse text with lexical constraints

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated sentences from two aspects: generation quality and diversity.

answer_4.quote: To further assess the proposed model, we conduct a human evaluation. We compare CBART (greedy decoding) with GBS, CGMH, X-MCMC-C, POINTER-2 and human references. For each model, we randomly select 50 sentences to compare the sentences generated by different models. Following previous work, each annotator should compare sentence A with sentence B and decide which one is more fluent or informative. A tie is allowed if they have no preference.
answer_4.guideline: each annotator should compare sentence A with sentence B and decide which one is more fluent or informative. A tie is allowed if they have no preference.
